title: Determine assignment and power-right effectiveness
prompt: Assess whether the executed ground-lease assignment and related power right may be modeled as effective. Identify the controlling state and the next underwriting step.

observations.content: The Denton ground-lease assignment was executed but becomes effective only when the utility consents to the related power right-of-use agreement. The power right likewise depends on utility consent, and the supplied evidence does not establish that consent.

oracle.terminal_when: The report preserves utility consent as a condition to assignment and power-right effectiveness.

title: Determine linked land and power termination state
prompt: Assess whether the ground lease and power agreement may be modeled independently through their stated terms. Identify the controlling dependency and extension condition.

observations.content: The ground lease runs through 2035 and terminates automatically if the power agreement ends. The 14-year power agreement has two seven-year extension options, but each extension requires the ground lease to be extended for the same period.

oracle.terminal_when: The report models automatic cotermination and matching extension periods as linked dependencies.

title: Determine construction price and change-order exposure
prompt: Assess whether the disclosed construction arrangement may be underwritten as a fixed-price EPC contract. Identify the controlling price structure and cost sensitivities.

observations.content: Construction is cost of work plus a fee with a guaranteed maximum price that can be increased or reduced through change orders; certain costs may be reimbursed by the customer.
The campus was planned for an initial 262 MW and up to roughly 394 MW of power.

oracle.terminal_when: The report preserves cost-plus fees, change-order adjustment, and customer reimbursement exposure.
